name: Congressional App Challenge
what_you_do: Build an app in any language and submit it to your House district. Winners are shown at the US Capitol.
who_can_apply: Middle or high school students who are US residents at the time of submission (citizenship not required). Students may compete in the district where they live or where they attend school. Solo or teams up to four. At least half the team must be eligible for the district the team competes in.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was October 26, 2026, and registration is closed. 2027 dates are not posted. In 2026, pre-registration opened Jan 1 and the challenge launched in May.
how_to_apply: Register on the Student Registration page, then submit the app online.
notes: Any language or platform is allowed, solo or teams up to four. Check the Participating Districts page on the site to confirm your district takes part. 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026, so the dates shown are from 2026.
